integrity: Analytical proof and a finite computational consistency checker; no claim of independent replication or certified priority. Prior coherent-vertex universality and empirical noise-dependence are credited.
scientific_limitations: No result for arbitrary initial states, adjacency-Hamiltonian evolution, heterogeneous dephasing, other observables, worst-case mixing time, or absorption. The signed integrated correlation need not be a probability or monotone time evolution.
scientific_scope: Finite simple undirected graphs with a designated universal vertex, at least three vertices, Laplacian unit-hopping Hamiltonian, uniform positive Haken–Strobl position dephasing, pure vertex-localized initial state. Integrated signed normalized hub return and fixed-ratio large-degree limit.
title: Exact integrated hub-return resonance under position dephasing
